name: Sawatari Michiru
source:
Hobbies: Teasing her brother
Loves: Her brother (very much!)
Dislikes: Fashionable clothes and accessories, people who illegally park their bicycles

Rei's younger sister, who was struck blind by a severe fever when she was younger. Extremely refined and old-fashioned, like a true "yamato nadeshiko", Michiru only cares about the present, not about the past or future. A genuine brocon, she is completely commited to her older brother.

"Dearest brother, might I kiss you just once?"
